title: CycloneDX AI/ML schema
$comment: OWASP CycloneDX is an Ecma International standard (ECMA-424) developed in collaboration between the OWASP Foundation and Ecma Technical Committee 54 (TC54). The standard is published under a royalty-free patent policy. This JSON schema is the reference implementation and is licensed under the Apache License 2.0.

bom-ref.title: BOM Reference
bom-ref.description:
An identifier which can be used to reference the model card elsewhere in the BOM. Every `bom-ref` must be unique within the BOM.
Value SHOULD not start with the BOM-Link intro 'urn:cdx:' to avoid conflicts with BOM-Links.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: The machine learning tasks that the model is designed to perform. This directly influences the model's intended use, input and output characteristics, and evaluation metrics. Models may support multiple tasks (e.g., multimodal models).

externalReferences.description: External references to information relevant to the model.

architectureName.title: Architecture Name
architectureName.description: The specific identifying name of the model architecture. This typically refers to well-known model variants or versions.

description.title: Description
description.description: A detailed description of the model's architecture, including key characteristics, design decisions, and architectural innovations.
examples: Decoder-only transformer with grouped-query attention and rotary positional embeddings, using a mixture-of-experts feed-forward layer.
Convolutional backbone with residual connections and a transformer head for multi-scale feature aggregation.

structural.description: Describes the model's primary and secondary architectural structure and network topology.

primary.$comment: Values not listed can be proposed to the CycloneDX Property Taxonomy.
primary.description: The core mathematical structural framework of the model backbone.

meta:enum.transformer: Architecture based on self-attention mechanisms for processing sequential or spatial data.
meta:enum.cnn: Convolutional Neural Network - architecture using convolutional layers for processing grid-like data.
meta:enum.rnn: Recurrent Neural Network - architecture with recurrent connections for sequential data processing.
meta:enum.lstm: Long Short-Term Memory - RNN variant with gating mechanisms for long-term dependencies.
meta:enum.gru: Gated Recurrent Unit - RNN variant with simplified gating compared to LSTM.
meta:enum.gan: Generative Adversarial Network - dual-network framework containing a generator and a discriminator.
meta:enum.vae: Variational Autoencoder - probabilistic encoder-decoder architecture mapping to a latent space.
meta:enum.mamba: State-space model architecture with selective mechanisms for efficient sequence modeling.
meta:enum.ssm: State Space Model - core architecture based on continuous or discrete state-space representations.
meta:enum.gnn: Graph Neural Network - architecture optimized for processing graph-structured data elements.
meta:enum.mlp: Multi-Layer Perceptron - classic feedforward architecture composed entirely of fully connected layers.
meta:enum.rwkv: Receptive Weighted Key Value - architecture combining parallelizable training with RNN-like inference.
meta:enum.snn: Spiking Neural Network - neuromorphic architecture utilizing discrete, time-dependent spiking activations.
meta:enum.kan: Kolmogorov-Arnold Network - architecture featuring learnable activation functions on edges rather than nodes.
meta:enum.diffusion: Denoising diffusion probabilistic model - iteratively refines noise into data (e.g., DDPM, Stable Diffusion).
meta:enum.flow-matching: Continuous normalizing flow trained via flow matching / rectified flow (e.g., Flux, SD3).
meta:enum.rbm: Restricted Boltzmann Machine - energy-based generative model with stochastic hidden units.
meta:enum.capsnet: Capsule Network - architecture using dynamic routing between capsule groups to preserve spatial hierarchies.
meta:enum.neuromorphic: Architecture designed for deployment on neuromorphic hardware (e.g., Intel Loihi, IBM TrueNorth).
meta:enum.hybrid: Explicit first-class combination of two or more distinct primary architectures (e.g., CNN+Transformer).

secondary.description: A list of secondary macro-layouts or component sub-networks built into the primary structure.

meta:enum.decoder-only: Autoregressive macro-layout processing data left-to-right (e.g., GPT series).
meta:enum.encoder-only: Bidirectional macro-layout processing complete sequences simultaneously (e.g., BERT).
meta:enum.encoder-decoder: Sequence-to-sequence structure mapping an input representation to an output sequence (e.g., T5).
meta:enum.mixture-of-experts: Sparse routing layer mechanism activating specific expert subnetworks per token.
meta:enum.vae-bottleneck: Symmetric compression bottleneck utilizing mean and variance latent vectors.
meta:enum.u-net: Symmetric contracting and expanding macro-layout featuring skip connections between corresponding scales.
meta:enum.residual-connections: Explicit skip or identity shortcuts bypassing one or more structural layers.
meta:enum.dual-encoders: Parallel feature extraction pipelines mapping different modalities into a shared space.
meta:enum.cross-attention-gated: Explicit sub-component routing that conditions one feature stream using another via attention mechanisms.
meta:enum.siamese-network: Twin identical subnetworks sharing identical weights to compute similarity metrics.
meta:enum.hybrid-backbone: Direct cascading combination of distinct primary layers (e.g., a CNN feature extractor feeding a Transformer).
meta:enum.state-space-model: State space model architectures using selective state spaces for sequence modeling (e.g., Mamba).
meta:enum.flow-matching: Flow-based generative model backbone using continuous normalizing flows.
meta:enum.vision-encoder: Vision encoding component for processing image inputs in multimodal architectures (e.g., CLIP, SigLIP).
meta:enum.adapter-layers: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning layers inserted into frozen models (e.g., LoRA, adapters).
meta:enum.projector-layers: Cross-modal projection components bridging different modalities (e.g., Q-Former, linear projectors).
meta:enum.gated-linear-units: Gated activation mechanisms using element-wise multiplication (e.g., GLU, SwiGLU, GeGLU).
meta:enum.speculative-decoding: Sub-network pairing a small draft model with a large verifier model to accelerate autoregressive generation.
meta:enum.rotary-position-embedding: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) sub-component encoding positional information via rotation matrices.
meta:enum.grouped-query-attention: Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) variant sharing key/value heads across groups of query heads to reduce KV-cache size.
meta:enum.sliding-window-attention: Attention mechanism restricting receptive field to a local sliding window (e.g., Mistral).
meta:enum.retrieval-augmented: Explicit retrieval sub-network prepended to or integrated into the model (e.g., RAG, RETRO).
meta:enum.memory-augmented: External or persistent memory bank integrated into the forward pass (e.g., MemGPT, Memorizing Transformers).
meta:enum.multimodal-fusion: Layer or block that fuses representations across more than one modality (e.g., cross-modal attention, FiLM conditioning).
meta:enum.reranker: Separate scoring / reranking head applied after an initial retrieval or generation step.
meta:enum.other: Other secondary architectural components not covered by the predefined categories.

topologyType.description: Specifies the runtime parameter activation and connection structure of the network layers.

meta:enum.dense: All or most parameters are active during inference with full connectivity between layers.
meta:enum.sparse: Only a subset of parameters are active during inference with selective connectivity.
meta:enum.dynamic: Parameter activation and connectivity patterns change based on input or runtime conditions.
meta:enum.liquid: Continuously adaptive network structure with time-varying connections and activations.
meta:enum.mixture-of-depths: Tokens are routed to different computational depths rather than different expert modules.
meta:enum.early-exit: Inference exits at the earliest layer that meets a confidence threshold, reducing compute for easy inputs.
meta:enum.recurrent-hybrid: Static layer layout that alternates between global attention and recurrent / SSM layers (e.g., Jamba, Zamba).

behavioralParadigm.description: The behavioral paradigm or modeling objective specifying how the system interacts with and learns data distributions.

specializedProcessing.description: The custom processing mechanisms, attention kernels, and hardware-software optimization pipelines.

externalReferences.description: references to external resources that describe the model architecture.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of performance metric used for AI model evaluation.

meta:enum.mmlu-pro: Massive Multitask Language Understanding Pro - The current standard for broad, expert-level academic and professional reasoning across multiple disciplines.
meta:enum.gpqa: Graduate-Level Google-Proof Q&A - A highly difficult dataset used to test advanced, PhD-level reasoning and scientific problem-solving capabilities.
meta:enum.math-500: A subset of the MATH benchmark used to evaluate complex, multi-step mathematical reasoning and logic.
meta:enum.humaneval: The industry standard benchmark for evaluating Python code generation and functional programming synthesis.
meta:enum.swe-bench: Software Engineering Benchmark - Evaluates a model's agentic ability to resolve real-world software engineering issues and patches within complete, live code repositories.
meta:enum.terminal-bench: Terminal-Bench - Evaluates an agent's ability to complete long-horizon, autonomous tasks inside a real shell environment, covering system administration, DevOps, and software engineering workflows.
meta:enum.gdpval: GDPVal - A cross-domain general performance validation benchmark measuring an agent's instruction-following, tool-use, and reasoning fidelity across diverse real-world tasks.
meta:enum.browsecomp: BrowseComp - OpenAI's benchmark for evaluating an agent's ability to answer hard, multi-hop research questions that require deep, autonomous web browsing to resolve.
meta:enum.bfcl: Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard - Evaluates a model's ability to correctly call external tools and APIs by selecting the right function and generating accurate, schema-conformant arguments.
meta:enum.taubench: τ-bench (TauBench) - An agentic benchmark assessing a model's ability to complete multi-step, tool-augmented tasks in simulated real-world domains such as retail and airline customer service.
meta:enum.ifeval: Instruction Following Evaluation - Tests a model's ability to strictly adhere to verifiable formatting constraints (e.g., specific word counts, starting sentences with specific words).
meta:enum.livebench: A frequently updated, contamination-free benchmark designed to test reasoning, math, and coding without the risk of models memorizing static test data.
meta:enum.webarena: An agentic benchmark evaluating a model's ability to perform complex, multi-step tasks using a web browser, APIs, and OS environments.
meta:enum.lmsys-elo: A crowd-sourced human preference rating derived from millions of blind A/B battle tests in the LMSYS Chatbot Arena.
meta:enum.strongreject: A standardized metric for measuring safety and alignment by evaluating how reliably a model refuses harmful prompts while avoiding false positives.
meta:enum.perplexity: A fundamental language model metric measuring how well a probability model predicts a sample. Lower perplexity indicates better prediction.
meta:enum.bleu: Bilingual Evaluation Understudy - A metric for evaluating machine translation quality by comparing generated text to reference translations.
meta:enum.rouge: Recall-Oriented Understudy for Gisting Evaluation - A set of metrics for evaluating automatic summarization and machine translation by comparing overlap with reference texts.
meta:enum.latency: The time delay between input submission and output generation, typically measured in milliseconds or seconds. Critical for real-time applications.
meta:enum.throughput: The rate at which a model processes requests or tokens, typically measured in tokens per second or requests per second.
meta:enum.coco: Common Objects in Context - A large-scale object detection, segmentation, and captioning dataset used to evaluate computer vision models.
meta:enum.vqa: Visual Question Answering - Evaluates a model's ability to answer questions about images, testing multimodal understanding.
meta:enum.imagenet: A large visual database designed for visual object recognition research, commonly used to benchmark image classification models.

modelTaskType.description: A machine learning task that a model is designed to perform.

meta:enum.text-generation: Generate coherent text continuations from prompts (e.g., GPT models).
meta:enum.text-classification: Classify text into predefined categories (e.g., sentiment analysis, topic classification).
meta:enum.token-classification: Classify individual tokens in text (e.g., named entity recognition, part-of-speech tagging).
meta:enum.question-answering: Answer questions based on context or knowledge (e.g., extractive or generative QA).
meta:enum.summarization: Generate concise summaries of longer text documents.
meta:enum.translation: Translate text from one language to another.
meta:enum.text-to-text: Transform text from one form to another (e.g., paraphrasing, style transfer).
meta:enum.fill-mask: Predict masked tokens in text (e.g., BERT-style masked language modeling).
meta:enum.sentence-similarity: Compute semantic similarity between text sequences.
meta:enum.text-to-image: Generate images from text descriptions (e.g., DALL-E, Stable Diffusion).
meta:enum.text-to-video: Generate video content from text descriptions.
meta:enum.text-to-audio: Generate audio or music from text descriptions.
meta:enum.text-to-speech: Convert text to spoken audio (speech synthesis).
meta:enum.image-classification: Classify images into predefined categories (e.g., ResNet, ViT).
meta:enum.image-segmentation: Segment images into regions or objects (semantic or instance segmentation).
meta:enum.object-detection: Detect and localize objects in images (e.g., YOLO, R-CNN).
meta:enum.image-to-image: Transform images (e.g., style transfer, super-resolution, inpainting).
meta:enum.image-to-text: Generate text descriptions from images (e.g., image captioning).
meta:enum.audio-classification: Classify audio into categories (e.g., sound event detection).
meta:enum.automatic-speech-recognition: Transcribe spoken audio to text (e.g., Whisper).
meta:enum.audio-to-audio: Transform audio (e.g., noise reduction, voice conversion).
